snippet.title: You Are Not Alice - First Trailer
snippet.description:
YOU ARE NOT ALICE – Official Trailer

Ever wanted to peek inside someone else’s inbox, slip into their identity, and watch the dominoes fall?

YOU ARE NOT ALICE is a social-engineering sandbox where conversation is your weapon.

What you’ll do

* Hijack employee workstations and poke around their files—personal, professional, and everything between.

* Chat your way through the org chart. Each employee has unique relationships, secrets, and soft spots just waiting for a well-timed DM.

* Plant the payload. Convince coworkers to open that virus.exe file and watch the infection spread computer by computer.

* Masquerade & manipulate. Log in as anyone you’ve compromised and decide whether to help, hustle, or humiliate.

* Uncover corporate mysteries. Every hard drive hides another breadcrumb… or bombshell.

No scripted paths. No right answers. Just an ever-shifting web of people, choices, and consequences that change every time you play—shaped entirely by how good you are at pretending to be someone you’re not.

Coming soon to Steam

Add YOU ARE NOT ALICE to your Steam wishlist (https://store.steampowered.com/app/3510450/You_Are_Not_Alice/) and join our Discord (https://discord.gg/PKZdBzj8uk) to swap exploits, theories, and hacking stories. Hit Subscribe and ring the bell so you don’t miss devlogs, Q&A sessions, and our other games.

Happy hacking—see you on the inside.
